heroLead: Southwest Greensburg is one of those small Westmoreland County boroughs that most people outside the area have never heard of, but the families who own land here have spent years fielding lease offers and letters they didn't know how to evaluate.
intro: Southwest Greensburg is a compact borough neighboring the county seat, and like the rest of central Westmoreland County, it sits within reach of the Marcellus wet-gas fairway that has drawn Range Resources, CNX, and other operators to the region. Even tightly built residential areas here can sit above active drilling units, since horizontal wells extend laterally for a mile or more from a surface pad located elsewhere.

A lot of families who reach out about property here inherited a small mineral interest from a relative who never drilled, leased, or even thought much about the gas rights attached to a house lot. That doesn't mean the interest is worthless, it just means nobody's checked.

sections.heading: Small Residential Lots Can Still Sit Over Active Units
paragraphs: Horizontal Marcellus wells can run over a mile laterally from their surface location, which means a small residential tract in a place like Southwest Greensburg can end up inside a producing unit even though there's obviously no well pad anywhere nearby. We check current DEP unit boundaries against your parcel before ruling anything out.

sections.heading: What We Need to Give You an Offer
paragraphs: A copy of your deed is the starting point. If you have a lease or division order, that speeds things along, but we can also pull most of what we need from the recorder of deeds records in Greensburg. From there, we give you a clear cash offer with no obligation.

faqs.question: My lot is small and residential. Could it still have mineral value?
faqs.answer: Yes, if it falls within an active drilling unit's boundaries. Horizontal wells can reach well beyond their surface pad location, so a small in-town lot can sit above a producing unit.

faqs.question: I never received a lease offer. Does that mean I have nothing to sell?
faqs.answer: Not necessarily. Some interests remain unleased even in active areas. We can check whether your parcel has been included in any unit or permit filing regardless of past lease history.

faqs.question: How fast can I get an actual offer?
faqs.answer: Once we have your deed and can confirm your interest, we typically provide an offer within a short turnaround, often within a week or two.
